WITH status_averages AS (
  SELECT rfistat, AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex
  FROM signals
  WHERE modindex IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rfistat
),
baseline AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as baseline_val
  FROM status_averages
),
above_baseline AS (
  SELECT 
    sa.rfistat,
    sa.avg_modindex,
    (sa.avg_modindex - b.baseline_val) as above_baseline
  FROM status_averages sa
  CROSS JOIN baseline b
  WHERE sa.avg_modindex > b.baseline_val
),
kept_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as mean_kept
  FROM above_baseline
)
SELECT 
  ab.rfistat,
  ab.avg_modindex,
  ab.above_baseline,
  (ab.avg_modindex - km.mean_kept) as diff_from_kept_mean
FROM above_baseline ab
CROSS JOIN kept_mean km
ORDER BY ab.rfistat
